summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. submitted a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, announcing a routine annual meeting of stockholders scheduled for September 10, 2026, in Monaco. The record date is July 15, 2026. The filing contains no business combination, tender offer, restructuring, activist campaign, or other special-situation event. It is simply a notice of an ordinary annual general meeting to elect directors and transact customary business. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as an equivalent of a U.S. proxy notice. No deal terms, premiums, prices, advisors, or structural mechanics are present. This filing is not a special situation; it is a routine current report.
